name: Web Security & Performance (Developer-Side)
description: A frontend developer's defensive security practices and client-side performance optimization. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: This skill covers security from a 'secure code authoring' perspective — correctly setting CSP headers, safely storing JWTs, sanitizing user input before rendering, configuring CORS. This is fundamentally different from the Cyber Security role's cs_threats_and_attacks and cs_cryptography skills, which approach the same topics from an attacker analysis, penetration testing, and cryptographic engineering perspective. Here the developer asks 'how do I prevent XSS in my React app?'; in Cyber Security the analyst asks 'how do I find and exploit XSS vulnerabilities?'.

subskills.name: XSS Prevention
subskills.description: Output encoding, DOMPurify sanitization, dangerouslySetInnerHTML risks, Content Security Policy as defense-in-depth.

subskills.name: Content Security Policy
subskills.description: CSP directives (script-src, style-src, img-src), nonce-based inline scripts, report-uri, strict-dynamic.

subskills.name: CORS Handling
subskills.description: Same-origin policy, preflight requests (OPTIONS), Access-Control-Allow-Origin, credentials mode, proxy workarounds.

subskills.name: Auth Token Storage
subskills.description: JWT storage trade-offs (httpOnly cookies vs localStorage), refresh token rotation, session management, XSS/CSRF attack surface.

subskills.name: CSRF Protection
subskills.description: SameSite cookie attribute, CSRF tokens, double-submit cookie pattern, origin/referer validation.

subskills.name: Core Web Vitals
subskills.description: LCP (Largest Contentful Paint), INP (Interaction to Next Paint), CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) measurement and optimization.

subskills.name: Bundle Optimization
subskills.description: Tree shaking, code splitting with dynamic imports, lazy route loading, dead code elimination, bundle analysis.

subskills.name: Image Optimization
subskills.description: Modern formats (WebP, AVIF), srcset and sizes attributes, lazy loading (loading='lazy'), CDN delivery, next/image.

subskills.name: Caching Strategies
subskills.description: Cache-Control headers, ETag/Last-Modified, stale-while-revalidate, Service Worker cache strategies (cache-first, network-first).

subskills.name: Runtime Performance
subskills.description: requestAnimationFrame scheduling, debounce/throttle, list virtualization (react-window), Web Workers for heavy computation, long task detection.
